title: The Freud/Jung Letters: The Correspondence between Sigmund Freud and C. G. Jung
summary: Edited by William McGuire, first published by Princeton University Press in 1974. Compiles the 360 letters that psychoanalysts Sigmund Freud and Carl Jung wrote to each other from 1906 until their break in 1914. Lionel Trilling reviewed it in The New York Times; the quality of the edition is widely recognised.
